newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's teachers to ring in the new year.
newsitem.headline: Israel's teachers to ring in the new year.

text.p: Israel's 130,000 schoolteachers will receive cellular telephones as the annual gift from their union and the Education Ministry, officials said on Thursday.
The gift, worth about $90, will test the educators' math skills: they must choose between connection to two rival cellular networks with complicated scales of air-time charges.
They will be joining some one million Israelis who already carry cellular phones. Israel is about to set up a third cellular network, owing to the popularity of the devices.
